topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class, outlines the themes of initiation and resolution of inflammation, and explains how previously introduced immune concepts will be integrated.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition in Innate Immunity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms and receptor systems by which the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage.

topics.label: Sentinel Cell Activation, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Systemic Consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells coordinate leukocyte extravasation into inflamed tissues and the broader systemic consequences of that inflammatory cascade.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inflammatory responses are shut down, how damaged tissues heal, and how the body manages unresolved inflammation.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer delivers brief closing remarks and announces the subject of the upcoming lecture.
